name: Holiday Inn Express (Herriman - South Jordan) One-Touch Conveyor Pancakes, Eggs & Turkey Sausage
brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Herriman - South Jordan (Herriman, UT)
whyItWorks: Pressing the button on the famous Holiday Inn Express conveyor pancake machine dispenses warm, oil-free, refined-flour silver-dollar pancakes in 60 seconds—paired with hot scrambled eggs, turkey sausage, and Chobani Greek yogurt.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Make 2–3 fresh conveyor-belt pancakes, pair with plain scrambled eggs (or a cheese omelet) and turkey sausage links, and grab a banana for the road.
watchOuts: Skip heavy peppery sausage gravy on the biscuits if flaring
